sections.title: Asking for Remedies
sections.content:
When visiting a pharmacy (*la farmacia*), use these key question patterns:
- *¿Tiene algo para...?*: Do you have something for...?
- *¿Tiene algo para el dolor de garganta?*: Do you have something for a sore throat?
- *Necesito unas pastillas para el dolor.*: I need some pain pills.

items.spanish: Buenos días, ¿tiene algo para el dolor de estómago?
items.english: Good morning, do you have something for stomach pain?

items.spanish: Tome una pastilla cada ocho horas con agua.
items.english: Take one pill every eight hours with water.

items.spanish: Para la garganta, recomiendo este jarabe.
items.english: For the throat, I recommend this syrup.

sections.content: Notice the phrase *para el dolor de...* (for the pain of...): *pastillas para el dolor de cabeza*.
